decisions.reason: As a close-to-core package extension for an existing anamnesis app, it is cheap to keep open, fits the firm's digital-practice strategy, and likely serves a niche large-practice segment without requiring a major new commitment.

Because it builds on the firm's established support capabilities and strengthens customer retention, management would likely keep testing it, though its service-intensive nature makes it somewhat more droppable than a simple software add-on.
